name: clinic.fountain/directory
title: Fountain
description: Search longevity clinics by treatment and location, and look up published treatment prices.

tools.name: search_clinics
tools.description: Find physical and mobile clinics by clinic name, treatment, or location. Supply the city separately from the search term. Use get_clinic to check individual services and prices.

query.description: Clinic name or treatment. Put the location in the separate city and country fields.

city.description: Exact city or locality, for example Austin.

country.description: Two-letter country code, for example US.

page.description: One-based page of 18 results. Defaults to 1.

tools.name: get_clinic
tools.description: Look up one clinic by its listing slug or numeric ID. Supply a treatment to narrow the menu to matching services, or omit it for the full menu. Returns published numeric prices, currencies, units, and a listing URL. Use offerings_page to read further items.

reference.description: The reference returned by search_clinics. A published clinic slug or numeric ID as a string.

treatment.description: Filter the menu by a service name or treatment before paging. Use matched_treatment from search_clinics when available.

offerings_page.description: One-based page of 25 published offerings. Defaults to 1.
